ext_name.description: Extension display name shown in chrome://extensions and the toolbar.

ext_description.message: Visualize the GitHub commit network (forks + main repo) in a dedicated tab. Manifest V3, no remote code, opt-out anonymous stats.
ext_description.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions (must be 132 chars or less).

action_default_title.description: Tooltip shown when hovering the toolbar icon.

popup_open_options.description: Popup link that opens the options page.

popup_launcher_title.description: Title of the graph launcher card in the popup.

popup_launcher_open_detected.description: Button label for opening the detected repository.

popup_launcher_not_on_github.message: Not on a GitHub repository page.
popup_launcher_not_on_github.description: Hint shown when the active tab is not a GitHub repository.

popup_launcher_input_placeholder.description: Placeholder for the manual owner/repo input.

popup_launcher_submit.description: Submit button label for the manual repo input.

popup_launcher_input_error.description: Validation error for invalid owner/repo input.

popup_recent_title.description: Heading for the recent repositories list in the popup.

popup_recent_aria_label.description: Accessible label for the recent repositories list.

options_saved.description: Status text shown after settings are saved.

options_mode_heading.description: Heading for the default graph mode section.

options_mode_description.message: The mode used when opening a new graph tab. You can switch temporarily in the graph header.
options_mode_description.description: Description of the default graph mode setting.

options_mode_legend.description: Fieldset legend for the default mode radio group.

options_mode_network_label.description: Radio label for the network (forks-inclusive) mode.

options_mode_network_desc.message: Show commits from forks in addition to the main repository.

options_mode_repo_only_label.description: Radio label for the repo-only mode.

options_mode_repo_only_desc.message: Show only commits from the main repository (fast and lightweight).

options_theme_heading.description: Heading for the color theme section.

options_theme_description.message: Choose a color theme for the popup, options page, and graph view.

options_theme_legend.description: Fieldset legend for the theme radio group.

options_theme_system_label.description: Radio label for following the OS color scheme.

options_theme_system_desc.message: Follow your operating system's light or dark setting.

options_theme_dark_label.description: Radio label for the dark theme.

options_theme_dark_desc.message: Mid-grey background, easy on the eyes in dim rooms.

options_theme_light_label.description: Radio label for the light theme.

options_theme_light_desc.message: White background with high contrast text.

options_view_source.description: Footer link to the project's GitHub repository.

relative_now.description: Relative time: less than a minute ago.

graph_header_brand.description: Brand label in the graph page header.

graph_mode_repo_only.description: Mode toggle button: main repository only.

graph_tab_title.description: Browser tab title of the graph page for a repository.

graph_branch_button.description: Branch jump menu button label in the graph header. $COUNT$ is the number of branches.

graph_branch_search_placeholder.description: Placeholder for the branch search input in the branch jump menu.

graph_branch_search_label.description: Accessible name of the branch search input.

graph_branch_no_match.description: Empty state shown when no branch matches the search query.

graph_refresh.description: Button label to refetch the current graph.

graph_loading.description: Loading indicator for the initial graph fetch.

graph_empty_commits.description: Empty state for a ready graph with zero commits.

graph_repo_prompt_prefix.description: Prefix of the prompt asking the user to enter a repo (rendered before the monospace owner/repo sample).

graph_repo_prompt_suffix.description: Suffix of the prompt asking the user to enter a repo (rendered after the monospace owner/repo sample).

graph_footer_load_error.description: Footer row error when loading older commits fails.

graph_footer_loading_more.description: Footer row text shown while older commits are being fetched.

graph_footer_will_load_more.description: Footer row text shown while waiting to load more.

graph_footer_retry.description: Retry button label in the graph footer row.

graph_repoform_label.description: Label for the repository input in RepoForm.

graph_repoform_placeholder.description: Placeholder for the repository input in RepoForm.

graph_repoform_error.description: Validation error for invalid input in RepoForm.

error_auth_heading.description: Heading shown for an authentication error.

error_notfound_heading.description: Heading shown when the repository is not found.

error_network_heading.description: Heading shown for a network error.

error_empty_heading.description: Heading shown when the repository has no commits yet.

error_shape_heading.message: GitHub may have changed its response format
error_shape_heading.description: Heading shown when the upstream response shape is unexpected.

error_http_heading.description: Heading shown for a generic HTTP error.

error_ratelimit_heading.description: Heading shown when GitHub answers HTTP 429.

error_pending_heading.message: GitHub is still building the graph
error_pending_heading.description: Heading shown when GitHub is still computing the network graph data (HTTP 202).

error_unknown_heading.description: Heading shown for an unknown error.

error_auth_body.message: You're not signed in to GitHub, or you don't have access to this repository.
error_auth_body.description: Body text for an authentication / access denied error from the GitHub network endpoint.

error_notfound_body.message: This repository doesn't exist, or it is private and you're not signed in to GitHub in this browser.
error_notfound_body.description: Body text for a 404 from the GitHub network endpoint.

error_network_body.description: Body text for a network failure. $CAUSE$ is the underlying error message.

error_empty_body.message: This repository has no commits yet.
error_empty_body.description: Body text for an empty repository (no commits).

error_shape_body.message: Couldn't load graph data from GitHub. The repository state may have changed, or the service may be temporarily unavailable.
error_shape_body.description: Body text for an unexpected upstream response shape.

error_shape_json_body.description: Body text for a JSON parse failure. $CAUSE$ is the underlying error message.

error_http_body.description: Body text for a generic HTTP error. $STATUS$ is the response status code.

error_ratelimit_body.message: GitHub is limiting requests from this browser right now.
error_ratelimit_body.description: Body text shown when GitHub answers HTTP 429 without saying how long to wait.

error_pending_body.message: GitHub is still computing the graph data for this repository. Press Retry in a moment.
error_pending_body.description: Body text shown when GitHub returns HTTP 202 (data still being computed) past our retry limit.

error_unknown_body.description: Body text fallback for an unknown error.

error_target_label.description: Label showing the owner/repo target of the failed request.

error_retry.description: Retry button label on the ErrorState card.

error_signin_link.description: Link label that opens GitHub's sign-in page.

commit_detail_select_prompt.message: Select a commit to see its details.
commit_detail_select_prompt.description: Placeholder shown in the commit detail pane when no commit is selected.

commit_detail_no_message.description: Placeholder shown when a commit has no subject/message.

commit_detail_action_open_github.description: Action: open the current commit on GitHub.

commit_detail_action_copy_sha.description: Action: copy the full commit SHA.

commit_detail_action_copy_short_sha.description: Action: copy the short commit SHA.

commit_detail_action_jump_parent.description: Action: select the parent commit in the graph.

commit_detail_parents_heading.description: Heading for the parents relation list.

commit_detail_parents_empty.description: Empty label for a root commit's parents list.

commit_detail_children_heading.description: Heading for the children relation list.

commit_detail_children_empty.description: Empty label when no children are visible in the current view.

commit_detail_changes_heading.description: Heading for the file changes section.

commit_detail_changes_loading.description: Loading indicator for the file changes section.

commit_detail_changes_no_files.description: Empty state for the file changes section.

commit_detail_changes_files_singular.description: Suffix after the file count when not truncated.

commit_detail_changes_files_truncated.description: Suffix after the file count when the list is truncated.

commit_detail_changes_truncated_note.message: Note: only part of the file list is shown. View the rest on GitHub.
commit_detail_changes_truncated_note.description: Note shown when the file list is cut short.

commit_detail_changes_error_ratelimit.message: GitHub's API rate limit was reached, so the changed files can't be shown right now. It resets within the hour; you can open the commit on GitHub meanwhile.
commit_detail_changes_error_ratelimit.description: Shown in the Changes section when the GitHub API rate limit is hit.

commit_detail_changes_error_ratelimit_re.message: GitHub's rate limit for unauthenticated requests (60 per hour) was reached, so the changed files can't be shown right now. It resets at $TIME$; you can open the commit on GitHub meanwhile.
commit_detail_changes_error_ratelimit_re.description: Shown in the Changes section when the rate limit is hit and the reset time is known. $TIME$ is a local clock time.

commit_detail_changes_error_auth.message: Access to this repository is required. Sign in to GitHub in this browser, then try again.
commit_detail_changes_error_auth.description: Shown in the Changes section when GitHub denies access.

commit_detail_changes_error_notfound.message: GitHub could not find this commit. If the repository is private, sign in to GitHub in this browser first.
commit_detail_changes_error_notfound.description: Shown in the Changes section when the commit is not found.

commit_detail_changes_error_network.message: Could not load the changed files. Check your connection and try again.
commit_detail_changes_error_network.description: Shown in the Changes section on a network failure.

commit_detail_changes_error_generic.message: Could not load the changed files from GitHub.
commit_detail_changes_error_generic.description: Shown in the Changes section for unexpected HTTP or response-shape errors.

commit_unknown_author.description: Fallback shown when a commit's author name is missing.

popup_telemetry_banner_text.message: We collect anonymous usage stats to improve the extension. No personal data, no repository names.
popup_telemetry_banner_text.description: First-run telemetry consent banner shown in the popup.

popup_telemetry_banner_dismiss.description: Button that dismisses the consent banner while keeping telemetry on.

popup_telemetry_banner_opt_out.description: Button that opts out of telemetry from the consent banner.

options_telemetry_heading.description: Heading of the telemetry section on the options page.

options_telemetry_description.message: Help improve the extension by sending anonymous usage and error events. No personal data, no repository names, no commit SHAs. You can opt out anytime.
options_telemetry_description.description: Explains what the telemetry toggle does.

options_telemetry_toggle_label.description: Label for the telemetry opt-out toggle.

options_telemetry_learn_more.description: Link text to the privacy policy detailing what is collected.

toast_copied.description: Toast shown after text was copied to the clipboard.

toast_copy_failed.description: Toast shown when copying to the clipboard failed.

toast_refresh_failed.message: Couldn't refresh. Showing the previous data.
toast_refresh_failed.description: Toast shown when a refresh fails while earlier data is still displayed.

graph_column_graph.description: Column header for the branch graph lanes.

graph_column_author.description: Column header for the commit author.

graph_column_subject.description: Column header for the commit subject line.

graph_column_sha.description: Column header for the abbreviated commit SHA.

graph_column_date.description: Column header for the commit date.

graph_tooltip_commit.description: Label of the abbreviated SHA in the commit hover tooltip.

graph_tooltip_parents.description: Label of the parent SHAs in the commit hover tooltip.

graph_mode_group_label.description: Accessible name of the mode toggle button group.

graph_mode_help_label.description: Accessible name of the help button next to the mode toggle.

graph_mode_repo_only_hint.message: Shows only commits from the repository you entered.
graph_mode_repo_only_hint.description: Help text for the main-only mode.

graph_mode_network_hint.message: Also shows commits from forks. This loads more data, so large networks can take longer.
graph_mode_network_hint.description: Help text for the include-forks mode.

graph_status_commits_one.description: Status line text when exactly one commit is loaded.

graph_status_commits_many.description: Status line text for several loaded commits. $COUNT$ is the number.

graph_status_more_available.description: Status line suffix when older commits can still be loaded.

graph_status_complete.description: Status line suffix when the oldest commit has been reached.

file_status_added.description: Accessible name of the file status badge: added.

file_status_modified.description: Accessible name of the file status badge: modified.

file_status_removed.description: Accessible name of the file status badge: removed.

file_status_renamed.description: Accessible name of the file status badge: renamed.

file_status_copied.description: Accessible name of the file status badge: copied.

file_status_changed.description: Accessible name of the file status badge: changed.

file_status_unchanged.description: Accessible name of the file status badge: unchanged.

relative_now_short.description: Compact relative time for under a minute ago, shown in the commit list.

graph_search_label.description: Accessible name of the commit search field.

graph_search_placeholder.description: Placeholder of the commit search field. The slash is the shortcut that focuses it.

graph_search_count.description: Search result count. $MATCHES$ is the number of matches, $LOADED$ the number of loaded commits.

graph_search_none.description: Search result text when nothing matches. $LOADED$ is the number of loaded commits.

graph_search_partial.message: Older commits are not searched yet.
graph_search_partial.description: Hint shown while a search is active and older history has not been loaded.

graph_search_load_older.description: Button next to the search result that loads older commits so they are searched too.

graph_search_previous.description: Button that selects the previous search match.

graph_search_next.description: Button that selects the next search match.

graph_list_label.description: Accessible name of the commit list.

commit_detail_panel_label.description: Accessible name of the commit detail panel.

commit_detail_action_copy_link.message: Copy link to this commit view
commit_detail_action_copy_link.description: Copies a link that reopens the graph on this commit with the same mode.

toast_commit_not_found.message: That commit was not found in the repository history. It may have been removed or belong to another repository. Try Refresh, or pick a branch instead.
toast_commit_not_found.description: Toast shown when the commit from the link or selection cannot be found after loading all history.

toast_commit_hidden_by_mode.message: That commit is only in a fork. Switch to "Include forks" to see it.
toast_commit_hidden_by_mode.description: Toast shown when the linked commit exists only in forks while forks are hidden.

graph_shortcuts_button.description: Header button that opens the keyboard shortcuts dialog.

graph_shortcuts_title.description: Title of the keyboard shortcuts dialog.

graph_shortcuts_close.description: Button that closes the keyboard shortcuts dialog.

graph_shortcut_first.message: Jump to the newest loaded commit

graph_shortcut_last.message: Jump to the oldest loaded commit

graph_shortcut_open_detail.message: Move focus to the commit details

graph_shortcut_back_to_list.message: Return from the details to the list

graph_shortcut_search_step.message: Next / previous match (in the search field)

graph_shortcut_search_clear.message: Clear the search (in the search field)

graph_shortcut_context_menu.message: Open the context menu for the focused commit

popup_recent_clear.description: Button that clears the whole recent repositories list.

popup_recent_remove.description: Accessible label of the button that removes one recent repository. $REPO$ is owner/repo.

popup_launcher_input_label.description: Accessible label of the manual repository input in the popup.

popup_telemetry_banner_label.description: Accessible name of the first-run telemetry notice in the popup.

graph_repo_switch_label.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the repository chip that opens the inline switcher.

graph_repo_switch_recent.description: Accessible name of the suggestion list in the inline repository switcher.

graph_repo_switch_hint.message: Enter to open · Esc to cancel
graph_repo_switch_hint.description: Keyboard hint below the inline repository switcher.

graph_repo_open_github.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the link that opens the repository on GitHub.

graph_status_refreshing.description: Status bar text while the graph is refreshed and the previous data stays visible.

graph_status_pending.message: GitHub is still preparing this graph. Large repositories can take a minute.
graph_status_pending.description: Reassuring text shown when GitHub keeps answering that the network data is not ready yet.

graph_status_seek_cancel.description: Button that stops the search for an older commit.

graph_branch_group_repo.description: Heading of the main repository group in the branch menu when fork branches are also listed.

commit_detail_branches_heading.description: Heading of the list of branches whose history contains the selected commit.

commit_detail_branches_empty.description: Empty label when no loaded branch tip contains the selected commit.

commit_detail_branches_show_all.description: Button that reveals every branch containing the selected commit when only the first few are listed.

graph_detail_collapse.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that collapses the details panel.

graph_detail_expand.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that expands the details panel.

graph_detail_resize.description: Accessible name of the drag handle that resizes the details panel.

graph_seek_title.description: Banner title while older pages are fetched to reach a branch or commit. $TARGET$ is a branch name or short commit hash.

graph_seek_progress_total.description: Progress text of the older-history search when the total number of commits is known.

graph_seek_progress.description: Progress text of the older-history search when the total is unknown.

graph_seek_busy.description: Tooltip of the busy indicator on the branch menu button while an older commit is being searched for.

toast_jumped.description: Toast shown after the list reached a commit that had to be loaded first. $TARGET$ is a branch name or short commit hash.

graph_detail_rail_label.description: Vertical label on the collapsed details panel rail.

graph_lanes_folded.description: Chip in the graph column header: number of lanes folded into the overflow gutter.

graph_lanes_folded_hint.message: $COUNT$ more lanes do not fit and are folded into the dashed line on the right. Select a commit to highlight its path there.
graph_lanes_folded_hint.description: Tooltip of the overflow chip in the graph column header.

error_server_heading.description: Heading shown when GitHub answers with a server error (HTTP 5xx).

error_server_body.description: Body text for an HTTP 5xx answer. $STATUS$ is the response status code.

error_ratelimit_body_wait.message: GitHub is limiting requests from this browser. It asked us to wait about $MINUTES$ min.
error_ratelimit_body_wait.description: Body text shown when GitHub says how long to wait. $MINUTES$ is a whole number of minutes.

error_hint_ratelimit.message: Wait a few minutes, then press Retry. You can keep browsing the repository on GitHub in the meantime.
error_hint_ratelimit.description: Advice shown under a rate limit error.

error_hint_network.message: Check your internet connection or VPN. If GitHub opens in other tabs but this keeps failing, GitHub may be blocking this connection for a few minutes; wait, then press Retry.
error_hint_network.description: Advice shown under a network error.

error_hint_server.message: GitHub may be having problems. Wait a moment, then press Retry.
error_hint_server.description: Advice shown under a server error.

graph_status_retry_ratelimit.message: GitHub is limiting requests. Retrying in $SECONDS$ s (attempt $ATTEMPT$ of $MAX$)…
graph_status_retry_ratelimit.description: Status text while waiting to retry after GitHub throttled a request.

graph_status_retry_network.message: Connection problem. Retrying in $SECONDS$ s (attempt $ATTEMPT$ of $MAX$)…
graph_status_retry_network.description: Status text while waiting to retry after a network failure.

graph_status_retry_server.message: GitHub had a problem. Retrying in $SECONDS$ s (attempt $ATTEMPT$ of $MAX$)…
graph_status_retry_server.description: Status text while waiting to retry after a GitHub server error.

graph_status_cooldown.message: Pausing requests to GitHub for $SECONDS$ s to let it recover…
graph_status_cooldown.description: Status text shown while new requests wait for an earlier failure to cool down.

popup_launcher_description.message: Open the commit graph for the current repository in a new tab.
popup_launcher_description.description: Description for the graph launcher card.

error_commit_notfound_body.description: Body text for a 404 on a single-commit detail fetch.

error_auth_denied_body.message: Access to the repository was denied.
error_auth_denied_body.description: Body text for a 403 (non-rate-limit) on a single-commit detail fetch.

error_auth_required_body.description: Body text for a 401 on a single-commit detail fetch.
